digest.component_or_area: live DC store-copy fixture & isolation test
propositions: The store-copy scrub removes .bridge_state* but the projects-seed ensure unit re-creates .bridge_state/projects.json when run_ensures is called after the scrub, resurrecting the artifact the scrub intended to remove

The seed_projects_mapping_unit was added after the original scrub logic and unconditionally commits .bridge_state/projects.json whenever its tree-check for git show tickets:.bridge_state/projects.json fails
A post-converge re-scrub of .bridge_state* with commit=True after run_ensures completes is required to remove resurrected artifacts from both worktree and tickets tree
The test_the_store_copy_is_complete_and_scrubbed isolation cell fails with AssertionError: binding/snapshot artifacts survived the scrub: ['.bridge_state']
